cases.name: Cassandra E. Gross
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Cassandra had earned her master's degree and had been an administrative assistant for ABB in Forest Hills."
cases.caseStatus: COLD CASE SOLVED; NO BODY CASE; PENDING
cases.narrative:
On 4/9/2018, she was reported missing when her blind and diabetic dog was found wandering alone in the Beatty Crossroads area.

Her burned-out vehicle was discovered near Twin Lakes Park, a short distance from where her diabetic dog was found unattended by a motorist. Searches have since found physical evidence, including pieces of Gross’ charred clothing and her eyeglasses, in a burn barrel on Stanko’s property.

She was legally declared dead in 2019, but her body has not been found.
